subject: general
question:
Substitute one word for the italicised expression.

The death of the veteran leader was followed by a year of *absence of Government* in the whole of North India.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2' **i.e. **' Anarchy.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct word** to substitute for the italicized expression **"absence of Government" is 2) anarchy.**
 
• **Anarchy **refers to a state of disorder, lawlessness, and absence or breakdown of government or authority. (अराजकता)
 
• **In the given sentence**, it **indicates** that after the death of the veteran leader, there was a period of chaos and lack of effective governance in North India.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: *The death of the veteran leader was followed by a year of **anarchy** in the whole of North India. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harmony **means a state of peaceful coexistence, agreement, or unity. (सामंजस्य)
 
• **Calm** refers to a state of tranquility, serenity, or absence of disturbance. (शांति)
 
• **Peace** refers to a state of freedom from disturbance, conflict, or war. (शांति)
